End effect: Wrong in-limit steering or acceleration command

Both integrity checks are 8-bit XOR over the same bytes: the SPI

(panda.cc:284-290). Any even number of bit errors in the same bit…

Unbounded SPI blocking. Control transfers use TIMEOUT 0, so

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
